messages:
anika: Kicking off a canary for model `redwood-3b-v2` in the catalog. Start 09:00 UTC, change window 09:00-11:00 UTC. Canary traffic: 5% hosted -> ramp plan attached. Pin dedicated customers to `redwood-3b-v1` for isolation. Please ack.
deploy-bot: deploy started: canary_id=canary-1780601123 region=us-west1 target=5% initiated_by=@anika
ryan_sre: watching latency and error budget. Alert thresholds set: 5xx > 2% or p95 latency > 250ms. I'll escalate if we breach. :eyes:
maria_ml: added fallback ordering in catalog config. Confirming order:
```\nfallback_priority: ["redwood-3b-v2", "redwood-3b-v1-quant", "redwood-2-7b"]\n```
Are we happy with that for hosted? Dedicated stays pinned to v1.
sam_pm: quick note for release notes: call out potential small behavioral drift on very long prompts (>= 8192 tokens). Linking eval run: https://internal.redwood/evals/runs/542
deploy-bot: canary_ramp scheduled: to 20% in 30m unless rollback requested by an owner.
lee_infra: can we ensure dedicated tenants are pinned for 24h? Some customers use legacy tokenizer pipeline.
anika: done. created pin: `catalog.pin(customer_selector: "dedicated", model: "redwood-3b-v1", duration: "24h", reason: "tokenizer mismatch")`
deploy-bot: canary metrics @ +20m -> errors=0.4% p95=180ms token_cost=+2%
ryan_sre: looks healthy so far. No 5xx spike. Monitoring dashboards green. :thumbsup:
maria_ml: spotted minor rerank delta on eval set id=42 at step=100. Delta=1.8% (threshold 1.5%). Flagging as potential quality regression.
anika: hold at 20% for now. We'll run the full eval suite at 1h. Rollback rule: regression > 1.5% OR ops breach -> rollback.
deploy-bot: executing scheduled ramp -> canary now at 50% (canary_id=canary-1780601123)
deploy-bot: manual rollback initiated by @anika — reason: quality_regression threshold exceeded (eval id=42). Rolling traffic back to stable models.
anika: Rollback started 11:12 UTC. Reverting default to `redwood-3b-v1` for hosted. Filing follow-up (action item) and postmortem task.
sam_pm: :disappointed: Any customer-facing incidents? Need language for the release note update.
ryan_sre: no 5xx or latency incidents observed, only model quality delta. No uptick in errors.
maria_ml: I'll open a PR for tokenizer adjustments and re-run the evals. Assigning to @maria_ml. Will include finer fallback tweaks to avoid hitting the quantized variant prematurely.
anika: thanks! I'll update the release notes and schedule a re-rollout after the fix. Good catch everyone!
